questions.key_step: x^2 sin(1/x): f' exists but is discontinuous
questions.justification: Textbook example met in every coaching sheet; one familiar fact, a few routine limit lines. Matches the single-trick Level 1 pattern.

questions.key_step: Match LHL, value and RHL; read off lambda, mu
questions.justification: 1^inf limit and a cot6x/cot4x limit at pi/2, then evaluate an expression; routine chain, no insight (slight ambiguity in how the printed exponent is typeset).

questions.key_step: f(0)=5, f(x+1)=4f(x) so f(n) is a GP
questions.justification: Cauchy-type functional equation plus GP sum; two routine ideas, short chain.

questions.key_step: Differentiate in x: f' constant, f linear
questions.justification: Standard additive functional equation with differentiability; a short routine chain.

questions.key_step: |x-[x]| = {x}; compare limits at 0 and 1
questions.justification: Rewrite with fractional part and check one-sided limits at two points; routine but needs care with signs of x(x-1).

questions.key_step: g(t)=t+1 only when f<0, i.e. x<-1
questions.justification: Composition of two piecewise functions: sort out the pieces, then continuity and one corner; routine multi-step.

questions.key_step: Compare the three terms: x+2 dominates for x<2
questions.justification: Three max terms with [x]; case analysis on two intervals and an endpoint; routine multi-step.

questions.key_step: [p sin x] has 2p-1 points of non-differentiability
questions.justification: Needs the horizontal-line count including the single touch at the peak; one slip (24 or 26) gives a wrong numerical answer and there are no options.

questions.key_step: Value and slope match at x=1; solve for k, m with surds
questions.justification: Two equations with surds, a quadratic, then two derivative evaluations; exact arithmetic with no options to check.

questions.key_step: |f|=f since f>=0; jump at -1, corners at 0 and 1
questions.justification: Piecewise with [x] on two sub-intervals, then counting a jump and two corners without options; moderate precision risk.

questions.key_step: Only the integers -1 and 0 lie in (-2,1)
questions.justification: Sketch of |[x]|+sqrt{x}; two jump points; numerical answer but short and routine.

questions.key_step: For x<3 the modulus gives -a/b; right limit is 2
questions.justification: Sign of a quadratic under modulus, one standard limit, solve b=2=-a/b; routine chain.

questions.key_step: f decreasing so the running minimum is f(x)
questions.justification: Needs the derivative sign, interpretation of the min over (0,x], then continuity and slope comparison; routine multi-step.

questions.key_step: Differentiate in x, then set y=x
questions.justification: Standard functional-equation-to-DE move; short chain.

questions.key_step: e^{-|ln x|} = min(x,1/x): one corner at 1
questions.justification: Single familiar move: remove the modulus and note the corner.

questions.key_step: a=b needed for a finite limit; b=1, c=0; check joins
questions.justification: Finite-limit condition, L'Hopital, two continuity equations and two slope checks; routine chain.

questions.key_step: Corners of |2x^2+5|x|-3| at 0 and at +-1/2
questions.justification: Two graph transformations in sequence, then counting corners; routine, no insight.

questions.key_step: Inequality in both orders squeezes f'(x)=1/x+1
questions.justification: Needs the two-sided derivative squeeze (an idea students rarely see), then a sum of squares; numerical answer.

questions.key_step: Match value and slope at x=2 (even function)
questions.justification: Remove the modulus, differentiate, solve two equations; routine chain.

questions.key_step: Left limit gives alpha=2; right limit gives beta/sqrt2
questions.justification: Two standard trigonometric limits and solving; short routine chain.

questions.key_step: (9^x-1)(8^x-1) factorisation and rationalisation
questions.justification: Factor, rationalise, apply standard limits, solve for a; routine multi-step with surds.

questions.key_step: Series expansion: beta=0, alpha=-3, f(0)=coefficient of x^3
questions.justification: Series with two unknowns and a coefficient read-off; routine multi-step.

questions.key_step: Jumps of [x^2] and [x] cancel at 1 and 2 only
questions.justification: Six doubtful points to test one by one; cancellation at two of them; one slip gives a different count, but options are given.

questions.key_step: Rationalise the right limit to b/(2a), left limit a+1+b
questions.justification: Two limits, two linear equations; routine multi-step with surds.

questions.key_step: [x/2] jumps at 2,4,6,8; [sqrt x] at 1,4; they cancel at 4
questions.justification: Two staircases with an overlap that cancels and endpoint handling; no options, precision risk.

questions.key_step: Exponent tan8x/tan7x tends to 0 (not 8/7) at pi/2
questions.justification: Two one-sided limits with a trap in the exponent, then integer solution; short routine chain.
